WITH la_legs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT id_bioguide FROM city_legislation.main.legislators_terms WHERE state = 'LA'
),
first_terms AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM MIN(CAST(term_start AS DATE))) AS first_year
    FROM city_legislation.main.legislators_terms
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
years AS (
    SELECT UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(1789, 2025)) AS y
)
SELECT y.y - ft.first_year AS years_elapsed, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.id_bioguide) AS num_legislators
FROM city_legislation.main.legislators_terms lt
JOIN city_legislation.main.legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
JOIN first_terms ft ON lt.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
JOIN years y ON CAST(y.y || '-12-31' AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE)
WHERE l.gender = 'M'
  AND lt.id_bioguide IN (SELECT id_bioguide FROM la_legs)
  AND y.y - ft.first_year > 30
  AND y.y - ft.first_year < 50
GROUP BY years_elapsed
ORDER BY years_elapsed;

    FROM city_legislation.main.legislators_terms

WHERE l.gender = 'M'
  AND lt.state = 'LA'
  AND y.y - ft.first_year > 30
  AND y.y - ft.first_year < 50

WITH first_terms AS (
